summary: Episode 24: Daily life resumed after the traveler's departure. In the souk Tariq overheard neighbors gossiping and felt tempted to join, but he held his tongue and offered a kind word instead. That evening Salim affirmed that speaking good or staying silent is itself part of faith. Tariq is learning to guard his speech. Noor still doesn't know who leaves the gifts at her door.
open_threads: Noor still doesn't know who leaves the anonymous gifts at her door (Tariq knows it is Salim)
Tariq is learning to guard his tongue and speak only good
The reading circle continues to grow
The traveler is gone, carrying the district's kindness into the world
